text.description_html:
Michael Healy MHCDOG08, Poodle Front Door Knocker

The Poodle Door Knocker is a great way to let your visitors know about the person and the dog living in your home. This wonderfully detailed Poodle Front Door Knocker captures the intelligence and alertness that Poodle dog breeds are known for. This door knocker is made from brass with a highlighted oiled bronze finish that really bring out the beauty of not only the coloring, but also the detailing. This Poodle Knocker comes packaged with the mounting hardware to install it on wood or metal doors.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Features and Specifications of the Poodle Door Knocker:

  • Material: Brass
  • Finish: Oiled Bronze
  • Height: 5-1/2"
  • Width: 4"
  • Projection Off Door: 3-1/2"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
